name: cuate
description: A cross-platform iMessage client and the headless server it talks to on the Mac. One shared core draws every screen; thin shells host it.
author: Abi Renhart

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-tokens.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-openapi.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-engine-bundle.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-engine-fixtures.mjs --check && node desktop/scripts/icons.mjs --check
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo "hooks installed: core.hooksPath -> .githooks"
